mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES keeps trending down while TRANSIT remains deeply depressed, weekday trip chains weaken and discretionary shopping demand falls further. That should push RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at or below their current four-week levels.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in RESIDENTIAL time indicates people are spending more time at home and substituting away from discretionary outings. Under that substitution pattern, RETAIL_REC should decline within one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL crosses above 15 points and stays elevated.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM rises while PARKS stays weak, essential errand mobility is not translating into broader leisure activity. That pattern predicts a short-lived or negative move in retail and recreation over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds PARKS by at least 20 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 7 days even though GROCERY_PHARM remains at least 20 points above PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT recovers by more than 10 points from its current depressed level, access to city-center retail improves and retail-and-recreation mobility should rise over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises more than 10 points from the current week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 28 days after TRANSIT rises by more than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained lift in PARKS combined with a simultaneous pickup in RETAIL_REC would indicate warmer-weather substitution from indoor retail to outdoor activity, which should keep retail-and-recreation mobility below the recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-four-week mean while PARKS also rises, contradicting a substitution effect.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains below -25 and TRANSIT stays below -65, commuting-linked retail trips remain constrained and discretionary retail should keep weakening within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A further decline in GROCERY_PHARM after a brief stabilization signals weaker errand consolidation and fewer out-of-home trips overall. That should lead retail-and-recreation mobility to move down over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM continues to soften or stays below 0.

mechanism_narrative: During tightening restrictions, a recovery in RESIDENTIAL alongside flat or falling WORKPLACES means people are staying home without compensating through work-linked visits. In that regime, RETAIL_REC should remain lower over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying elevated and WORKPLACES not recovering.
